description: Gets the electricity price for the current delivery period (15- or 60-minute slot) in one market: the all-in household price and the wholesale spot price, per kWh, in the market's own currency and in EUR. All-in = variable household price per kWh: spot + energy tax + per-kWh grid fee + VAT. Fixed monthly charges (grid capacity, tax credits) are excluded. Spot = wholesale day-ahead price.

market.description: Market code from list_markets, e.g. "NL", "DE" or "SE3".

name: get_current_price
title: Current electricity price
